column1: # rsx-frame sample: the register state each captured draw must show (`ps3dk-prof rsx-frame --json`, draw "state"),
# one field per row, tab-separated: ordinal ("*": every draw), table, field, expected JSON value. Tables: render,
# surfaces, index, textures.<slot>, attributes.<index>. The values follow source/main.c (surface(), fixed_function(),
# bind_texture(), bind_vp()) and the attribute slots the compiler gives POSITION, COLOR and TEXCOORD0 (0, 3, 8); a
# field not listed is not checked. Fields that depend on the display (sizes, offsets) or on memory placement are left
